description: This file contains storage-related functions for managing observability webhooks and dead letter queues, including CRUD operations and configuration management.

classes.name: LocalStorage
classes.description: A storage handler providing methods to manage observability webhooks and dead letter queues.

methods.name: GetObservabilityWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves the global observability webhook configuration from the database.

methods.name: SetObservabilityWebhook
methods.description: Stores or updates the global observability webhook configuration in the database.

methods.name: DeleteObservabilityWebhook
methods.description: Removes the global observability webhook configuration from the database.

methods.name: AddToDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Adds a failed observability event to the dead letter queue.

methods.name: GetDeadLetterQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries in the dead letter queue.

methods.name: GetDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Retrieves entries from the dead letter queue with pagination.

methods.name: DeleteFromDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Deletes specific entries from the dead letter queue by IDs.

methods.name: ClearDeadLetterQueue
methods.description: Removes all entries from the dead letter queue.
